title: Owner Rewards Tenure Multiplier on Earned Points — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Tenure schedule for Service Accounts and Repair Orders points.** The tenure multiplier follows how long the account has been open and its tier:

| Whole months from the account's opening date to the crediting date | Account tier | Points multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | 1.25 |
| 60 or more | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 1.1 |
| Fewer than 60, or any other tier | — | not multiplied |

The crediting date is the day the points are credited. A whole month is complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Edges (hypothetical dates).** Account opened 17 October: on 17 October five years later it has 60 whole months; on 16 October that year, 59.

**Hypothetical.** 1360 points on a Gold account open 72 whole months become 1700; on a Silver account, 1496.
